architectures.name: Snowflake-style embedded generator
architectures.summary: Each node composes timestamp, node ID, and a local sequence.
architectures.bestWhen: Very high rates and no central dependency are needed.

architectures.name: Range allocation service
architectures.summary: A service hands out blocks of sequential IDs that nodes consume locally.
architectures.bestWhen: Compact sequential IDs are preferred and clocks are untrusted.
drawbacks: IDs are not time-sortable across nodes.
